This is the perfect start for Afghanistan. Fazalhaq and Omarzai picked up the top three in the powerplay, while Sami got the big wicket of Taylor. And Rashid Khan hasn't bowled a ball yet. This partnership between Raza and Burl is going to be crucial if Zimbabwe are to get out of this hole.
